name: Canvas LMS
summary: A cloud-based learning management system for creating and delivering courses, assessing learning, communicating with learners and monitoring progress. Instructure currently presents Canvas in Core, Plus and Next tiers, with different levels of engagement, analytics and AI functionality.

value: IgniteAI tools across tiers with advanced capabilities in Next

value.notes: Institutional pricing not publicly listed; contact sales. Individual educator offering: free, with limitations. Institutional quote. Tiers: Canvas Core, Plus and Next.

value.freeTierNote: Canvas Lite / Free-for-Teacher is available for individual educators with feature limitations; institutional Canvas is quote-based.
value.trialNote: Institutional demo / pilot by enquiry; no standard public trial terms identified

value.evidence: WebAIM independently evaluated a representative sample of Canvas LMS and reported WCAG 2.2 A/AA conformance for the sampled content. This is not a guarantee for institution-authored content, third-party tools or every configuration.

security.notes: SOC 2 Type II: vendor trust-centre statements; request current reports and confirm scope

value.notes: AWS regional hosting options include Australia, Canada, EU and USA; confirm availability for the specific Canvas product and contract. Instructure states customer data is stored in the selected region. Confirm product-specific scope, subprocessors and cross-border support access.

Instructure AI features; third-party model/provider details vary by feature. Instructure AI features; third-party model/provider details vary by feature. Instructure says it does not use student data to train its AI models, and customer data is not used to train its AI systems unless the institution authorises it. Feature-level models are listed in its AI Nutrition Facts.

accessibility.finding: WebAIM, an independent accessibility organisation, verified a representative sample of Canvas LMS as conformant with WCAG 2.2 Levels A and AA. Instructure also publishes a VPAT.
accessibility.caveat: WebAIM's verification covers the sample as of 26 June 2025. The WebAIM certificate for the Canvas mobile apps has expired.

security.finding: Instructure states ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 Type II reports, renewed in December 2025; SOC 2 reports are available under NDA.
security.caveat: A cybersecurity incident took Canvas offline in May 2026 (restored 9 May 2026). Ask for the post-incident report.

dataResidency.finding: Instructure says Canvas data is stored in the customer's region on AWS; its third-party processor guide lists Australia among processing locations.
dataResidency.caveat: Confirm the tenant region, backups and support access in the contract.

ai.finding: Instructure says it does not use student data to train its AI models, and customer data is not used to train its AI systems unless the institution authorises it. Feature-level "AI Nutrition Facts" list the models used.
ai.caveat: Check each AI feature's nutrition facts before enabling it.

procurementChecks: Current Canvas LMS VPAT, SOC 2 Type II report, ISO certificate and HECVAT Australia tenant region, backups, disaster recovery, subprocessors and support access locations Feature-level IgniteAI Nutrition Facts, provider/model list, retention and third-party processing schedule.

researchTasks: Integrations need exact names: "LTI 1.3 ecosystem; REST APIs; SIS integrations; SSO; extensive third-party integrations. Confirm entitlements and partner data flows.".
